description: Four train slimes of species C on the fusion dip's floor, sizes 2, 2, 3 and 1 from left to right, about a slime apart, made of the eight C sleepers nearest the dip (the others asleep at their markers), and the first slime at its marker. Both bumps can happen: 2 + 2 and 3 + 1. For fusion (chunk 10; four slimes since chunk 16).
